segments.text:
ALL thoſe that are juſtified, God vouchſafed, in, and for the ſake of his only Son Jeſus Chriſt, to make partakers of the Grace of Adoption; by which they are taken into the number, and enjoy the Liberties, and Priveledges of Children of God; have his name put upon them, receive
the Spirit of Adoption,
have acceſs to the throne of Grace with boldneſs, are enabled to cry Abba Father, are pitied, protected, provided for, and chaſtned by him, as by a Father; yet never caſt off; but ſealed to the day of Redemption, and inherit the promiſes, as heirs, of everlaſting Salvation.
